newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech cuts Illinois rates by $45 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech cuts Illinois rates by $45 mln.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Thursday it is cutting rates to residential and business customers in Illinois by $45 million, effective July 10.

Ameritech had sought approval for a rate reduction from the Illinois Commerce Commission in April of $39.2 million, which included $20.5 million in cuts to residential customers, $12.1 million to businesses and $6.6 million to cellular customers.
"Ameritech is determining now where the additional cuts will fall," said Ameritech spokeswoman Lisa Kim.
On July 9, Ameritech will file with the ICC the new rates to reflect the $45 million reductions.

Ameritech, a regional Bell company, provides communications services incuding local and long distance telephone, cellular, paging, security monitoring, cable TV, electronic commerce, and on-line services.
Shares of Ameritech were trading unchanged at 69-1/8.
